chunks: Those are the real unbelievers. And We have reserved for the unbelievers an ignominious punishment.
ai.seo_question: Who are the real disbelievers and what punishment is prepared for them?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often linked to the specific context of the hypocrites (al-munafiqun) who outwardly professed Islam but concealed disbelief, highlighting the distinction between nominal faith and true conviction. The 'humiliating punishment' (adhun muhin) is interpreted not merely as physical suffering but as a spiritual degradation resulting from their own deceit. This reinforces the Shia emphasis on sincerity (ikhlas) and the reality of the Ahl al-Bayt's authority as the true bearers of divine guidance.
